messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] error loading library after updating aroma.affymetrix
parts:
Hi,

thanks for letting me know. I managed to reproduce that problem, but
it really puzzles me why it occurs. That code, digest::digest(...,
skip = skip, ascii = ascii), is only used if you have digest v0.3.0
(tested for), which is yet not publically available, and you certainly
have v0.2.3. So, it shouldn't be called, but for some reason it is.
I'll track it down.

Workaround, because I'm prepared for my own mistakes ;), is to do:

options("aroma.affymetrix::assertDigest"=FALSE)
library(aroma.affymetrix)
digest <- .digest.fix023

...and then it should work as usual.

Henrik
